children: Computational molecular discovery platform's Q3 revenue rose 19% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Net loss widened to $37.7 mln from $32.8 mln last year
Drug discovery revenue rose, helped by milestone payment from Structure Therapeutics
Schrodinger raises 2026 ACV guidance to $222 mln-$232 mln from $218 mln-$228 mln
Company lifts 2026 drug discovery revenue outlook to $75 mln-$85 mln from $65 mln-$75 mln
Operating expenses for 2026 expected to be less than in 2025
MILESTONE PAYMENT - Drug discovery revenue increase was primarily due to a milestone payment from Structure Therapeutics
HOSTED SOFTWARE TRANSITION - Software gross margin fell 2% as company continued transition to hosted licenses
OPERATING EXPENSES - Operating expenses decreased 13% yr/yr, contributing to improved operating results
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Schrodinger Inc is $24.00, about 11.7% below its November 3 closing price of $27.18
